Definition: to hide (by covering over); by implication, to hoard or reserve; figuratively to deny; specifically (favorably) to protect, (unfavorably) to lurk
BiblicalUsage: Tsaphan is hiding — and treasuring what is hidden. The psalmist hid God's word in his heart so he would not sin against Him; the LORD hides His own in His pavilion in the day of trouble; and Moses' mother hid her baby three months from Pharaoh's decree. Proverbs says to hide God's commandments with you, the way a man hides treasure.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the best hiding place in the Bible is God's word in the heart and God's people in His presence. My position is that what we treasure we hide, and what we hide shapes us — so I hide His word where my life is lived. I hold that God hides His own in trouble, and no enemy can find what God has hidden.
